unknown: Could not tell whether this connection is metered ({why}).
intro: These packages download more data while they are installed:
ask: Answer n to the question below and nothing is downloaded.
unattended: No question is asked here (-y, or no terminal), so the installation goes on and the download starts when the package is set up.
malformed: The install-time download declared by {package} is ignored: {why}.
hook_error: The install-time downloads could not be read ({why}); nothing was checked.
